excluded_dates.reason: forecast orbit (least accurate geolocation); waiting for the reprocessed product

motion.convention: Line-of-sight change relative to the median of this window. Ionosphere screen removed; troposphere not corrected. Check the GUNW product specification for the sign convention.

motion2d.note: Size and vertical/east-west split are reliable; whether vertical motion is up or down is not confirmed, because NISAR's product specification does not state the phase sign convention.

validation.method: Gamma likelihood-ratio change-point test with Conradsen (2016) omnibus gate; HH and HV combined with a Satterthwaite correction for their measured correlation
validation.note: Simulated speckle from correlated complex-Gaussian looks (HH-HV coherence 0 to 0.9), not real NISAR labels.
